title: Titanium Downhole Production Tubing
alloyReason: Grade 23 Ti-6Al-4V ELI (UNS R56401) is mandated for Titanium Downhole Production Tubing where extra-low interstitial elements (O ≤0.13%, Fe ≤0.25%) provide superior fracture toughness (KIC >100 MPa√m) and fatigue crack growth resistance compared to standard Grade 5. The controlled oxygen content reduces susceptibility to strain-rate embrittlement, making it the preferred choice for Downhole production tubing liner joint (Grade 28) in safety-critical applications. This rationale is driven by downhole production tubing liner joint (grade 28) and service environment demands.
process: Ring forging radial-axial for oil & gas geometry
CNC turn-bore operation for net-shape tolerance
TIG welding autogenous for net-shape tolerance
Hydrostatic pressure test for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for downhole production tubing application
inspection: UT wall thickness scan (downhole production verified)
commonFailures: Erosion-corrosion at pipe bend <3D radius - remedied by +2mm wall thickness in directional change zones — critical for downhole production tubing performance

faq.q: How does Titanium Downhole Production Tubing perform in deep-sea pressure environments?
faq.a: Titanium Downhole Production Tubing fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V is suitable for full-ocean-depth operation (11,000 m, 110 MPa external pressure). With 830 MPa yield strength and spherical/cylindrical collapse pressure margins >2× for downhole production tubing, titanium's strength-to-weight ratio provides the deepest diving capability per unit mass of any structural metal. Buckling analysis per API 1111 is provided for each design.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Downhole Production Tubing orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Downhole Production Tubing is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Downhole Production Tubing?
faq.a: Each Titanium Downhole Production Tubing shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for downhole production tubing.

sceneDescription: Titanium Downhole Production Tubing is a marine-grade downhole production tubing component designed for Downhole production tubing liner joint (Grade 28). Fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V, it provides immunity to seawater corrosion, chloride stress corrosion cracking, and biofouling — eliminating the need for cathodic protection in submerged service.
